title: Run the SpecSync archive gate before every CI job
description: Run the SpecSync archive gate before every CI job
no_spec_change_rationale: CI workflow ordering only; no canonical spec owns .github/workflows
acceptance_criteria: trust.yml and atlas.yml each start with an archive-gate job named Archive that runs CorvidLabs/spec-sync pinned to 106aaa43d0bcf049f19b173ddb63815a25c3f931 with archive-gate-only 'true'; every other job in those workflows needs archive-gate directly or transitively, so nothing else runs while a change under .specsync/changes/ is open.
